title: Bug Hunt Station 1 - Hero Card (TypeError)
body:
Goal: find and fix the bug using the traceback.

  1. Open starter.py and press Run. Red text appears: a traceback.
  2. Read it from the bottom up:
    • The last line says what went wrong. Write it down.
    • The lines above say where: which line number, in which function.
  3. Before you change anything, say out loud (or to a rubber duck) what card_line("Level", 4) should give back, and what the code really does.
  4. Fix the bug. Run again.

Done looks like:

Hero: Zoe the Brave
Level: 4
Coins: 120
Next level: 5

Detective notes: fill in the bug report in your workbook: error name, line number, what you changed.

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read the red text from the bottom up. The last line says what went wrong, and the line above it points to the function and line number. Which function is it?

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: In Python, + can join text to text, or add numbers to numbers. It cannot mix them. "Level: " + 4 fails because 4 is a number, not text. Your job is to make the line work for any kind of value.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: An f-string puts any value into text, like f"Score: {points}". Rewrite the return in card_line() as an f-string. Look at the "Done looks like" box to see what plain text goes between the two parts in curly braces.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Bug Hunt Station 1: Hero Card
# This program has a bug. Press Run and read the error from the BOTTOM up:
#   1. the last line says WHAT went wrong,
#   2. the line above it shows WHERE (file name and line number).
# Fix the bug, run again, then run it again to check.


def card_line(label, value):
    """Return one line of the card, like "Level: 4"."""
    return label + ": " + value


def make_card(name, level, coins):
    """Return a list of card lines for a hero."""
    return [
        card_line("Hero", name),
        card_line("Level", level),
        card_line("Coins", coins),
        card_line("Next level", level + 1),
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for line in make_card("Zoe the Brave", 4, 120):
        print(line)
